basic_profile.bio: Originally from the Pacific Northwest, I'm a software developer with a newfound interest in virtual reality and gaming. In my spare time, I love exploring new VR experiences and tinkering with technology. I'm currently working remotely, which gives me the flexibility to engage with my hobbies more extensively. I am single and often online during evenings and weekends. I enjoy learning about cybersecurity and the latest tech trends, and I'm always on the lookout for seasonal work opportunities to mix things up.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in computer science, I've spent years honing my skills in software development. Recently, I've taken an interest in cybersecurity, exploring resources like the 'cissp' subreddit to expand my understanding. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-directed learning, often driven by curiosity and industry demands.
